meta.title: MATH 7TH — Grade 7 Mathematics
meta.description: An interactive platform for studying Grade 7 mathematics on the Syrian curriculum: original textbook lesson pages, plus a quiz for every lesson and every unit.

home.title: Grade 7 Mathematics
home.subtitle: Study the textbook exactly as it is written, page by page, then test yourself with a quiz for every lesson and a full quiz for every unit.
home.step1Body: Browse the curriculum units in the order they appear in the textbook.
home.step2Body: Read the original lesson pages with comfortable zoom and pan on any device.
home.step3Body: A quiz for every lesson and a full quiz for every unit, with instant marking and explanations.
